root_cause: The navigation controller sets aria-activedescendant to the option's data-value (label) instead of the option's ID, causing the input to reference incorrect active descendant.
repair_strategy: Replace the use of list[currentFocus].dataset.value with list[currentFocus].id when updating aria-activedescendant in the navigation controller's update function.
expected_accessibility_effect: Arrow navigation will correctly update aria-activedescendant to point to the active option element, enabling screen readers to announce the highlighted suggestion.
functional_risks: No functional risks identified; the change only affects the ARIA attribute used for active descendant tracking.
verification_requirements: After typing 'ma' and pressing ArrowDown, aria-activedescendant on #store must equal 'autoCompleteJS_result_0'.
After a second ArrowDown, aria-activedescendant must equal 'autoCompleteJS_result_1'.
Pressing Enter while an option is highlighted must fill the input with that option's value and submit the form.
